evidence.name: Screen field: Color the close (X) icon
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Color the close (X) icon" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Color the close (X) icon
sections.description: Sets the color of the X dismiss icon (default white; applies only when the close button is shown). Choose a color that contrasts with whatever sits behind the header — dark over a light hero image, white over a dark one — so users can always find and tap it. Low contrast here can leave people feeling trapped on the paywall.
